name: chatfate
description: Generate deterministic Bazi or Liuyao charts and evidence-linked reports in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Choose Liuyao or Bazi and generate a private structured report.
interface.longDescription: ChatFate presents a two-stage card for Liuyao or Bazi, calculates deterministic facts on its hosted service, asks Codex for evidence-linked interpretation, and opens a private report in the built-in Browser.
